details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It carries no functional code — the main entry point exports an empty object — but its preinstall and postinstall hooks each issue a single HTTP GET to hxxp://38[.]242[.]235[.]206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/{preinstall,postinstall}, sending the local username, the host name and the current working directory as query parameters so the author can identify which build resolved the name from the public registry. No credentials, tokens, environment secrets or file contents are collected, and no further code is downloaded or executed. Requests: hxxp://38[.]242[.]235[.]206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/preinstall and hxxp://38[.]242[.]235[.]206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/postinstall
